title: Untitled Space Game
author: Project_Eva_01
selftext:
Wanted to share a project I've been working on. It is very rough. Annihilation is meant to be a content title, I have no actual title for the game yet.  
  
I am primarily a backend engineer (API, Infrastructure, Kube/Docker, Tooling). So my video game smarts (Graphics, 3D design, etc) is not very good.

Claude has been helping me with that part. I'm a big fan of EVE Online, and wanted to make a clone  but with expanded features.

Some features I have but not showing in my video:

1. You can land on certain planets which turns into a 4v4 FPS. Ships in space can fight, and when one is destroyed, it will crash down onto the planet and cause damage to players near the crash.
2. There are missions you can do for Yuan (currency I picked for the game) to buy items in the market, and improve your ship.
3. There are four ships a player can use (Miner, Assault, Frigate, Battle).
4. Online play is enabled (there is a separate server backend not shown).
5. Sovereignty, players can take over space (as somewhat shown in my star map).

However, the overall loop is not fun. I am trying to find ways to make it better. EVE Online also has the same issue, it becomes very stale over time.

The graphics are generated in game, that is why they are rough. The music is also musical keys turned to code, so the game runs without any assets/textures/etc.

I thought it be fun to share here.
